text:
alyssa: Heads-up — Enterprise prospect (FinReg Inc) says they'll only sign Dedicated if we commit to SOC2 + ISO + EU data residency. Sales wants ETA and tradeoffs.

maria: They've been in pilot 6 months. If we don't give a clear timeline they'll go to a competitor. Willing to pay, but wants SOC2 Type II within ~3 months.

sam: SOC2 Type II realistically ~4-6 months (controls + evidence + ops). ISO 27001 another ~3 months if done in parallel. Data residency depends on region infra — sometimes weeks, but needs legal + KMS work.

jordan: Engineering estimate: SOC2 controls + infra changes = ~5 eng-months + audit prep. If we scope an MVP (infra, logging, access controls) we could aim for ~3 months.

alyssa: Quick RICE thinking: Reach = this customer $1.2M ARR, broader enterprise reach medium. Impact = high. Confidence ~60%. Effort = 5 eng-months. Rough RICE suggests prioritizing but need numbers.

kevin: Note: GDPR residency isn't purely infra — contracts (DPA) + processing addenda take time. ISO helps procurement for other deals.

rita: Multiple current customers flagged SOC2/ISO as renewal blockers. Churn risk exists if we push this out.

jordan: Another option: ship Feature X (payments plugin) next quarter to drive revenue, then backfill compliance. Risk is sales won't close without SOC2.

sam: Proposed sequence: 1) SOC2 readiness MVP (controls + logging + infra) — 3 months. 2) Parallel legal/DPA work. 3) ISO prep next quarter. 4) Region-by-region residency rollouts. This shortens time-to-sign.

maria: If we offer an interim commitment (SOC2 Type I / DPA + contractual clauses) and a clear cert timeline (canary commit), they might sign earlier.

alyssa: Can we quantify revenue vs cost? If we delay Feature X by a quarter that's ~ $200k. Accelerating compliance increases engineering load.

jordan: Quick calc: Compliance bundle (Reach=150 enterprises, Impact=9, Conf=0.6, Effort=20 eng-months) → RICE ≈ (150*9*0.6)/20 = 40.5. Feature X (Reach=300, Impact=4, Conf=0.8, Effort=6) → (300*4*0.8)/6 = 160. Feature scores higher by raw RICE.

sam: RICE here misses legal/regulatory gating risk. If compliance is required to close, its effective impact is binary — we should surface that.

alyssa: Proposal: Two-track roadmap. Track A: Compliance sprint — SOC2 MVP + DPA templates prioritized for named enterprise target list. Track B: Feature roadmap continues but we deprioritize non-critical items for 6 weeks. PMs + eng leads to align on exact commit list by EOD Friday. Agree?

maria: :thumbsup: I'll own the negotiation playbook updates and feed feedback from FinReg.

kevin: I'll draft the DPA addendum and list contract clauses that need legal review.

jordan: I'll produce a delivery plan with milestones and a minimal-scope SOC2 MVP by tomorrow.

rita: I'll compile the list of customers flagged for compliance-related renewals.

sam: I'll run a gap analysis doc and post it to #eng-security.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: SOC2-readiness-checklist doc created by sam — https://redwood.docs/soc2-gap

alyssa: Thanks — reconvene Friday 10:00 to lock priorities and RICE adjustments.
